content.heading: From the README
content: A software package to visualise page dependencies without having to view the page content: the set of navigable items of a webpage, linking from page to page within the World Wide Web.
GraphBrowser is the GUI counterpart of PagerTS, built with Quarkus and web technologies - the same dependency list that pagerts parses with JSDOM into `title`, `url` and `resources`.
